data.body:
ROOT CAUSE — the AWS code-review bot host, via an unpopulated OPTIONAL SSM parameter.
GitHub Actions is RULED OUT.

CHAIN OF EVIDENCE
1. env b2b5c498's event files are committed to the tickets branch by git committer
   'Rebar Bot <joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com>' — note the display name has a SPACE. This
   developer machine commits as 'RebarBotNava' (no space), same email, so the committer name
   is the discriminator between the two.
2. 'Rebar Bot' is the DEFAULT identity set by infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh:35
   NAME="${REVIEWBOT_GIT_USER_NAME:-Rebar Bot}" — the AWS review-bot's store-write path.
3. REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY is referenced in infra/scripts/fetch-secrets.sh and the three
   GitHub Actions workflows — but NOT in reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh. The review-bot path
   sets a git identity and never arranges signing.
4. fetch-secrets.sh (~line 93) fetches the key OPTIONALLY and documents this exact outcome:
     'OPTIONAL: the Rebar Bot ed25519 authorship signing key (story 245e) ...
      Blank => the reviewbot writes unsigned (its types are gate-exempt, so this is
      attribution only).'
   The key is only materialized when the SSM slot rebar-bot-signing-key is non-empty. It is
   evidently empty on the running host, so the reviewbot writes unsigned exactly as designed.
5. Event-type profile corroborates: CREATE 1185 / LINK 1100 / REVIEW_RESULT 1187 are near
   equal — the per-review 'create a ticket, link it, record the result' shape of
   reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh — plus the enrichment-queue drain it also runs.
6. GitHub Actions EXONERATED: .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml has an explicit
   'Materialize the Rebar Bot signing key' step, and its envs are 100% signed
   (rebar-bridge[bot] envs) / 50% (reconciler). Only b2b5c498 is 0%.

WHERE THE DESIGN NOTE UNDERSTATES THE IMPACT
The comment justifies unsigned writes as 'attribution only' because the reviewbot's types are
gate-exempt. But this env also writes 1185 CREATE events, and the envelope author resolves to
'Unknown' (author_id null, author_email empty, creation_channel null) — so it is not merely
unsigned, it is UNATTRIBUTED. 1185 tickets have no author of record.

OPERATOR ACTION
Populate the SSM parameter <prefix>/rebar-bot-signing-key with the Rebar Bot ed25519 key and
restart the review-bot container so fetch-secrets.sh materializes it and exports
REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY. Then confirm new events from that env carry author_sig and a
resolved author.
